issues.description: Method getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): the UML diagram in problem_statement.md declares the method return type as void, while the textual task description in problem_statement.md and the solution implementation in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java declare and implement it as returning a String (format: "LectureName (TotalNumberOfStudents)"). This contradiction can confuse students about the correct signature to implement and lead to incorrect implementations or failing tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML in problem_statement.md so the signature for getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() shows a return type of String. Ensure the textual description and any UML/diagrams consistently state the method returns String formatted as "LectureName (TotalNumberOfStudents)" so students implement the correct method signature.
